name: InfoWorld

sources.title: InfoWorld Contact Us — 'To submit story ideas... contact editors via the link in their bylines'; Expert Contributor Network pointer (content read via search result)
Foundry Expert Contributor Network — 1,200-1,500-word practitioner articles; register interest via form; contact edward.murray@foundryco.com (content read via search result)
InfoWorld About Us — product reviews coordinated via Executive Editor Doug Dineley (doug_dineley@foundryco.com); reviews written by hired independent experts (content read via search result)

requirements: Not a directory — earned editorial and a documented contributor program (Foundry Expert Contributor Network)

Contributor Network seeks IT leaders/practitioners for 1,200-1,500-word articles on AI, cloud, data management, enterprise apps, emerging tech — published across CIO, Computerworld, CSO, InfoWorld, Network World
Contributors sign a Writer Agreement; editors help build the post
Story ideas go to individual editors via byline links — no central pitch inbox
Product reviews are written by hired independent experts — contact Doug Dineley (doug_dineley@foundryco.com) to discuss a review
preparation: For the contributor network: a working title/topic plus a few sentences synopsis; hands-on practitioner credibility
For coverage: identify the editor/writer covering your beat via article bylines
Enterprise-developer/IT-leadership angle — consumer SaaS is a weak fit
workflow: For bylined coverage: read recent InfoWorld stories, pick the relevant writer, pitch via the byline contact link
For a product review: email doug_dineley@foundryco.com
For contributed articles: register interest on the Expert Contributor Network form or email edward.murray@foundryco.com, then pitch a topic synopsis
Publication, if it happens, is a staff-written article, a commissioned review, or your contributed article under your byline
watchFor: A product announcement is not a contribution pitch — the network wants practitioner insight articles, not launches
Reviews are commissioned by InfoWorld's editors, not submitted — offer the product for review, don't write it yourself
Foundry (ex-IDG) runs multiple brands — the same contributed piece may appear on CIO/Computerworld/CSO/Network World
Contact pages were verified via search results; direct fetch returned 404 on an old URL
countsAsLive: An InfoWorld article/review mentioning the product is published at infoworld.com (or your contributed article appears under your byline)
unknowns: Contributor pay/compensation terms — not stated on the network page
Current acceptance rate for cold contributor applications
